review: Fixes of a live trial of the owner-decisions package through the canonical CLI: an unadopted memory configuration refused by name, recall with a relative state directory, a REPL whose channel fails, project connect exit codes, Gold run ids and run directories, source knowledge verified in another runtime
method: one mutation at a time in a fresh copy of the working tree, four copies in parallel; its killer files run alone, in order, the targeted cases first, each in its own pytest process with -x, until one fails; the file restored byte for byte (sha256 verified) before the next mutation; every kill was checked to be a failing test of the mutated behavior
mutation_identity: sha256 of the production file's bytes with the mutation applied

scopes.unadopted_configuration: a durable run whose memory configuration the owner has not adopted is refused before it starts, by name (MemoryOwner.require_bindable, MemoryFactory.check_binding)
scopes.recall_relative_state: project recall accepts a state directory named relative to the working directory
scopes.repl_closed_channel: a REPL whose input or output fails ends once with one error line and its exit code
scopes.connect_exit_code: import roots that name nothing at the connected commit exit like a malformed declaration
scopes.run_id_reuse: a Gold run's declaration and run directory are checked before its memory job is requested; a run id requested with other inputs is refused by name
scopes.source_runtime_drift: source knowledge verified in another runtime is an environment mismatch

survivors_explained.F8-05: A failure to read a published claim's sources again at its revision now applies the knowledge. The sources were regular files at that commit and were read when the claim was verified; a commit's tree does not change, so reading them again fails only in a damaged repository.
survivors_explained.F8-06: Knowledge verified at another revision now applies. A run evaluates only candidates of its own revision: in two probes through the canonical CLI (explicit and automatic task targets), knowledge learned at a later commit of another branch never reached the compatibility evaluation, and its repository_revision dimension would refuse it (INCOMPATIBLE_REVISION) in any case.
survivors_explained.F8-07: Bindings outside the task's scope now apply. The allowed_scope dimension compares the same paths (a source descriptor's allowed scope is the set of its binding paths), so the knowledge is still refused (INCOMPATIBLE_SCOPE instead of INCOMPATIBLE_TASK_CONTRACT); only the explanation changes.
survivors_explained.F8-08: Source bytes other than the verified ones now apply. The bytes of a path at a commit are the ones the verifier hashed when it published the claim; they differ only in a damaged object store.

excluded_from_mutation: the REPL banner's text and frame (no test pins cosmetic text), and a support file recorded by its path as named instead of resolved (the same path for the absolute, symlink-free paths a frozen declaration names)
